Introduction

Vince, formerly known as Joe Rhee, is a South Korean singer-songwriter, producer & composer under The Black Label. He made his debut in February 11, 2014 with the digital single "Love No.2". On September 11, 2019 it was announced that he would re-debut under the stage name Vince. On October 2, 2019, he released the single MENNAL featuring rapper Okasian. In 2023 he released his debut EP 'The Drive'.

As a composer, his credits include in some of the biggest songs in k-pop. Most notably, Vince has frequently worked with BIGBANG, iKON, Taeyang ('Vibe', 'Shoong'), G-Dragon ('SUPERSTAR') , Sunmi ('Gashina') , BLACKPINK ('Pretty Savage', 'Shut Down'), Jeon Somi ('XOXO', 'Fast Forward') among many others.

In 2025, Vince participated in the compositions of the tracks 'Your Idol' & 'Soda Pop' from the Netflix animated film 'K-Pop Demon Hunters'. He has also worked on the debuts of MEOVV & ALLDAY PROJECT.
